title.hr: Rokovi za otklanjanje ranjivosti: prosjek i rep
title.en: Vulnerability fix deadlines: the average and the tail

concept.hr: Postotak u roku izgleda dobro, a rep na sustavima bez vlasnika nosi rizik
concept.en: The share fixed in time looks fine; the tail on unowned systems holds the risk

summary.hr: Postavi rokove po ozbiljnosti i kapacitet tima, pusti godinu ranjivosti, složi red po ocjeni ili iskorištavanju; čitaj postotak, izloženost i najstariju.
summary.en: Set deadlines by severity and the team's capacity, run a year of vulnerabilities, queue by score or exploitation; read the share, exposure and oldest.
